import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 15;
    static final int MAXM = 100005;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static char[][] A = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] B = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int n, Tlim, zx, zy, S, T, tot;
    static int[][] id = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] dFromZ = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] seen = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] queArr = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] disLevel = new int[MAXN * MAXN * 2 + 5];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN * MAXN * 2 + 5];
    static int edgeCnt = 1;
    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[MAXM];
    static int[][] dFromCell = new int[MAXN][MAXN];

    static class Pt {
        int x, y;
        Pt(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; }
    }

    static class Edge {
        int to, next, cap;
        Edge() {}
        Edge(int to, int next, int cap) { this.to = to; this.next = next; this.cap = cap; }
    }

    static boolean valid(int x, int y) {
        if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= n || y >= n || seen[x][y] == 1 || A[x][y] < '0' || A[x][y] > '9') return false;
        return true;
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
        edges[++edgeCnt] = new Edge(v, head[u], c);
        head[u] = edgeCnt;
        edges[++edgeCnt] = new Edge(u, head[v], 0);
        head[v] = edgeCnt;
    }

    static void bfsFromZ() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(dFromZ[i], INF);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(seen[i], 0);
        Queue<Pt> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dFromZ[zx][zy] = 0;
        seen[zx][zy] = 1;
        q.add(new Pt(zx, zy));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pt cur = q.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = cur.x + dx[k], ny = cur.y + dy[k];
                if (valid(nx, ny)) {
                    dFromZ[nx][ny] = dFromZ[cur.x][cur.y] + 1;
                    seen[nx][ny] = 1;
                    q.add(new Pt(nx, ny));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void buildLinks(int sx, int sy, int node) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(seen[i], 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(dFromCell[i], INF);
        Queue<Pt> q = new LinkedList<>();
        seen[sx][sy] = 1;
        dFromCell[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new Pt(sx, sy));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pt cur = q.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = cur.x + dx[k], ny = cur.y + dy[k];
                if (valid(nx, ny)) {
                    dFromCell[nx][ny] = dFromCell[cur.x][cur.y] + 1;
                    seen[nx][ny] = 1;
                    if (dFromCell[nx][ny] < dFromZ[nx][ny]) q.add(new Pt(nx, ny));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (dFromCell[i][j] <= Tlim && B[i][j] > '0' && B[i][j] <= '9' && dFromCell[i][j] <= dFromZ[i][j]) {
                    addEdge(node, id[i][j] + tot, INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean bfsLevel() {
        Arrays.fill(disLevel, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        disLevel[S] = 0;
        q.add(S);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
                int v = edges[i].to;
                if (edges[i].cap > 0 && disLevel[v] == -1) {
                    disLevel[v] = disLevel[u] + 1;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return disLevel[T] != -1;
    }

    static int dfsFlow(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == T) return flow;
        int usedFlow = 0;
        for (int i = head[u]; i != 0 && flow > 0; i = edges[i].next) {
            int v = edges[i].to;
            if (edges[i].cap > 0 && disLevel[v] == disLevel[u] + 1) {
                int ret = dfsFlow(v, Math.min(edges[i].cap, flow));
                if (ret > 0) {
                    edges[i].cap -= ret;
                    edges[i ^ 1].cap += ret;
                    flow -= ret;
                    usedFlow += ret;
                }
            }
        }
        if (usedFlow == 0) disLevel[u] = INF;
        return usedFlow;
    }

    static int maxflow() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfsLevel()) {
            int f;
            while ((f = dfsFlow(S, INF)) > 0) ans += f;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        Tlim = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) A[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) B[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
        }

        // find Z
        outer:
        for (zx = 0; zx < n; zx++) {
            for (zy = 0; zy < n; zy++) {
                if (A[zx][zy] == 'Z') break outer;
            }
        }

        // assign ids
        tot = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                id[i][j] = ++tot;
            }
        }

        S = 2 * tot + 1;
        T = S + 1;

        bfsFromZ();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (A[i][j] > '0' && A[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(S, id[i][j], A[i][j] - '0');
                    buildLinks(i, j, id[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (B[i][j] > '0' && B[i][j] <= '9') {
                    addEdge(id[i][j] + tot, T, B[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxflow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
